knowledge_gaps: Padding failures need attribution to the current checkpoint, encoder and diagnostic readout. Historical failures do not establish that the supplied corrected cold start needs another encoding repair.
The experiment sequence omits baseline loss with recency weighting. Without that arm, it measures weighting conditional on BPR-max but cannot estimate whether the two interventions interact.

Normalizing weights within each sampled batch or window defines a different objective from full-history exposure normalization. Absolute event weights remain fixed across crops, but their normalized contributions can change. State the intended objective and sampler exposure law explicitly.

The pseudocode implements only BPR-max, lacks the baseline-objective branch, and leaves valid_rows undefined. Specify absolute-index alignment, negative-scoring tensor shapes, reduction units and empty-unit handling before implementation.

The proposed negative-score penalty sweep lacks coefficients and an exact formula. With replacement, duplicate negatives also receive repeated softmax mass; document this behavior and preserve identical sampling across objective controls.

The report supplies neither a concrete affordable trial count nor resolved validation cadence and checkpoint tie-breaking. Historical combined_score values need provenance before treating their differences as evidence. Repeated validation selection can overfit the fixed 800-user evaluation.

Originality 3 is reasonable; potential 7 remains speculative, and difficulty 4 may underestimate sampler, padding and predictor integration. The current idea remains a reasonable first experiment; the evidence does not yet justify switching to temporal gates.
